name: 44621 · Dennison, OH
findings: ZIP 44621 (Dennison) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44621 (Dennison) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
